description: Give OpenVibe.Actor one A2A (agent-to-agent) task: POST /a2a/v1/tasks with a message (text parts) and an optional skill. The caller is a Network service token with this capability acting for a person (X-OV-Subject); the task runs under that person's allowance, budget and allow-list, exactly like a task they started, and answers with the A2A task (actor.a2a-task-result@1). The agent card is /.well-known/agent.json. Anonymous callers are refused (401) and a token without this capability is refused (403).
